title: [main] bug 648733 - Add integration event for updating original document VAT date in General Ledger Setup CZL
summary: An integration event was added to the UpdateOriginalDocumentVATDateCZL procedure in General Ledger Setup CZL to allow extensions to customize the behavior when the original document VAT date is updated.
key_points: Integration event enables custom logic when source fields change (posting date, document date, VAT date)
Procedure sets Original Doc. VAT Date CZL field in Purchase Header based on Default Orig.Doc. VAT Date CZL setting
Resolves extensibility gap in the call chain from handlers through validation
quote: The integration event for updating original document VAT date in General Ledger Setup CZL has been added
